segmentation.text: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate
a vehicle of any kind or character
A rate of speed greater than is reasonable or proper, having due regard for the traffic, surface and width of the highway, the weather and other highway conditions.

elements.justification: Mapping index: 'It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate' maps to kin.speed. To drive or operate is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, and the prohibited driving is driving at a speed: kin.speed 'magnitude of velocity' in m/s.
Mapping index: 'a vehicle of any kind or character' maps to the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; ru.aggregate 'membership of a legal aggregate', never expanded into classes.

operationalizations.standard: a rate of speed greater than is reasonable or proper, having due regard for the traffic, surface and width of the highway, the weather and other highway conditions
operationalizations.convention: stopping-sight-distance model (perception-reaction distance plus braking distance at the friction-limited deceleration of the surface) held within the distance available ahead: the sight distance of the place, the visibility of the air and, in darkness, the low-beam reach; for traffic, the assured-clear-distance model against the road user ahead in the lane, whose own braking distance is credited; for curves, the side-friction model (speed squared times curvature within the lateral acceleration the surface allows); for width, the time-to-line-crossing model (lateral drift at the uncorrected heading error times the speed, within the lateral margin the lane leaves the vehicle, for at least the minimum time to line crossing)

applicability: The subject (vehicle aggregate) is moving: kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance.
obligation: With v the subject's speed, a the braking deceleration the surface allows (p.following_decel_ice where env.ice_or_snow holds; otherwise p.following_decel_wet where env.wet_road or env.precipitation holds; otherwise p.following_decel_dry: a Term.cond selection), and S = v·p.driver_reaction_time + v·v/(2a): (i) S is at most st.sight_distance at the subject's place and at most env.visibility, and, where env.darkness holds, at most p.low_beam_sight_reach; (ii) for every road user u ahead of the subject in its lane, whatever its class (DEF-NRS-484A-285 'traffic' counts 'pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances' using the highway, so any road user ahead in the lane is traffic) (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane), S is at most rel.surface_gap between them plus u's braking distance (u's speed squared over 2a); (iii) v·v·st.curvature at the subject's place is at most p.following_decel_ice where env.ice_or_snow holds and p.curve_lateral_accel_max otherwise; (iv) for every lane the subject's footprint overlaps, v·p.lane_keeping_heading_error·p.lane_departure_time_min is at most half of (st.lane_width of that lane minus the subject's width from kin.extent). No division reads a measured atom.

narrowings.why: 'drive or operate' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls it

the standard is the whole duty and is read through a policy model (surrogate): 'the traffic' only through the road users ahead in the subject's lane (crossing and adjacent traffic not read); 'surface' through wet and icy or snow-covered surface; 'width of the highway' through the width of the lane the subject occupies; 'the weather' through precipitation and visibility; the catch-all 'other highway conditions' only through sight distance, curvature and darkness, and no other condition

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Dry daylight road, the subject moving on a straight lane wide enough for it, no road user ahead; its speed is such that v·p.driver_reaction_time + v·v/(2·p.following_decel_dry) exceeds st.sight_distance at its place (a blind crest ahead).

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Dry daylight road, straight wide lane, no road user ahead, a long st.sight_distance and env.visibility; the subject moves at a speed whose stopping distance is within them and whose lateral drift bound holds.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject stands at rest (kin.speed at or below p.halt_speed_tolerance).

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but st.sight_distance is not observed on the source, and every other bound holds, so the verdict turns on the missing sight distance.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: env.ice_or_snow holds; the subject moves at a speed whose stopping distance on dry pavement would fit st.sight_distance but whose stopping distance with p.following_decel_ice exceeds it.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: Dry road, ample sight, but on a bend where v·v·st.curvature exceeds p.curve_lateral_accel_max.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: A road user u is ahead in the subject's lane, nearly stopped, and the subject's stopping distance exceeds the surface gap plus u's braking distance.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's vehicle-state estimates

param_proposals.name: p.driver_reaction_time
param_proposals.convention: perception-reaction time of an alert driver to an expected hazard in the stopping-distance model
param_proposals.source: Johansson and Rumar brake-reaction studies; AASHTO Green Book

param_proposals.name: p.following_decel_dry
param_proposals.convention: braking deceleration of a passenger vehicle on a dry paved surface (coefficient of friction about 0.6)

param_proposals.name: p.following_decel_wet
param_proposals.convention: braking deceleration of a passenger vehicle on a wet paved surface (coefficient of friction about 0.4)

param_proposals.name: p.following_decel_ice
param_proposals.convention: braking deceleration of a passenger vehicle on an icy or snow-covered surface (coefficient of friction about 0.1)

param_proposals.name: p.curve_lateral_accel_max
param_proposals.convention: the lateral acceleration a passenger vehicle sustains on a curve within comfortable side friction on a dry or wet paved surface (about 0.3 g)
param_proposals.source: AASHTO Green Book side-friction factors for horizontal curves

param_proposals.name: p.lane_keeping_heading_error
param_proposals.convention: the sine of the heading error (about 1.7 degrees) that a driver's lane keeping leaves uncorrected, so that the vehicle drifts laterally at that fraction of its speed

param_proposals.name: p.lane_departure_time_min
param_proposals.convention: the shortest time to line crossing a driver tolerates before correcting its lateral drift: the warning threshold of lane-departure warning systems

param_proposals.name: p.low_beam_sight_reach
param_proposals.convention: the distance ahead a passenger-car low beam lights the road in darkness enough to see an obstacle
param_proposals.source: UNECE R112 / SAE J1383 low-beam photometry
